disposition_reason: 130 dehydrated instant soups (poultry, meat, vegetable) bought in Tenerife were analysed for Al, Cd and Pb by ICP-OES; Table 3 prints mean, SD, max, min and median per soup type.

study.design: retail survey of instant (dehydrated) soups with dietary intake assessment
study.market: supermarkets and shops, Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
study.method: dry ashing at 450 °C, dissolution in 1.5% HNO3, ICP-OES (Thermo iCAP PRO)
lod: instrumental LOD (mg/L): Al 0.005, Cd 0.0007, Pb 0.0009; LOQ Al 0.015, Cd 0.002, Pb 0.003 (printed '0003')
study.qa: SRM 1515 apple leaves (Al 109.3%, Pb 94.8%), SRM 1573a tomato leaves (Cd 92.3%)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EDI for a 20 g dry portion vs EFSA TWI Al 1 mg/kg bw/week, Cd 2.5 µg/kg bw/week, Pb BMDL 0.63 and 1.50 µg/kg bw/week
